componentNaming: Local evidence identifiers derived from observed CSS roles; not official platform component IDs

requirements.requirement: Do not render carousel indicator dots
requirements.observed: Captured small/medium/large carousels have pagination containers with display:none. Hidden DOM nodes must not be treated as visible UI.

requirements.requirement: Video decoration is outside this project scope; do not collect or implement video modules.
Current capture retains only the minimal signboard and its children; product list is out of scope.
Capture the fullscreen carousel signboard as reference; implementation remains undecided and must not be treated as mandatory MVP scope.

corrections.reason: Backend display label identifies default. Image upload recommendation ratios do not reliably identify rendered signboard type.

limitations: Rounds 1/2: viewport width 483 CSS px. Minimal/fullscreen signboards: 577 CSS px. Read source.viewport per module; do not compare widths as identical. Heights depend on content/item count and may depend on viewport.
Styles represent current states; no complete interaction or responsive behavior specification.
01-home.json has a narrower property set than 03-updated-home.json; expand only when necessary.
Module root heights must not be used as single image slot aspect ratios.
02-category-panel.json contains 2000 returned nodes and may be truncated; not counted in decoration coverage.
